description:
Bring photos from compatible classic Panasonic Lumix cameras straight to your iPhone. Retro LUMIX Sync connects directly to the camera's local Wi-Fi, shows the SD card as a fast photo gallery, imports original JPEG files into Apple Photos, and lets you shoot with the camera from your iPhone.

VALIDATED FIRST ON GM1S
The Panasonic DMC-GM1S is the primary camera validated on real hardware. Use Wi-Fi → New Connection → Remote Shooting & View → Direct → Image App. The related DMC-GM1 and DMC-GM5 are the closest additional targets.

BROWSE THE CAMERA
• Load the newest photos first
• Scroll through the complete camera card
• Open a larger preview before importing
• Select one photo or a batch

KEEP THE ORIGINAL
Retro LUMIX Sync imports the original JPEG advertised by the camera. It does not recompress the image or delete anything from the SD card.

REMOTE SHOOTING
See the camera's live view on your iPhone. Take photos, start and stop videos, tap to focus, and change exposure settings the camera offers remotely. When you go back to the gallery, the camera switches to playback and your new photos appear.

RECEIVE PHOTOS WHILE YOU SHOOT
Use the camera's Send Images While Recording mode, and each JPEG arrives on your iPhone as you take it and is saved to Apple Photos. The receiving screen can join the camera's Wi-Fi for you. Receiving works while that screen is open.

OPTIONAL GEOTAGGING
Start a visible location log before shooting. Add the geotagging widget to your Home Screen to start or stop logging with a tap; the app includes setup instructions. During import, Retro LUMIX Sync can match the camera's EXIF capture time to a nearby track point and add that location to the Apple Photos asset. Location logging is off by default, and track data stays on the iPhone unless you write it to your camera. You can also paste a Google Timeline JSON export or choose a location on a map and keep that manual location for future imports.

WRITE LOCATIONS TO THE CAMERA
When you choose to, Retro LUMIX Sync sends your recorded track to the camera, which writes GPS data into the matching photos on its card. You can also set the camera's clock from your iPhone so photo times line up with your track.

CAMERA COMPATIBILITY
Panasonic's Image App ecosystem covers many classic Lumix models. The following are research candidates, not blanket compatibility claims; support must be verified on each camera and firmware:

• Micro Four Thirds system cameras: DMC-GM1, GM1S, GM5; DMC-GF6, GF7, GF8; DMC-G6, G7/G70, G80/G81/G85; DMC-GH4; DMC-GX7, GX8, GX80/GX85; DC-GF9/GX800/GX850, GH5, G9, GH5S, GF10, GX9, G90/G91/G95/G95D.
• Bridge and premium compacts: DMC-FZ1000, FZ300/FZ330, FZ2000/FZ2500; DMC-LF1, LX100, LX9/LX10/LX15; DC-FZ80/FZ82, LX100M2, FZ1000M2/FZ10002.
• Travel and rugged compacts: DMC-FT5/TS5, FT6/TS6; DMC-SZ9, SZ10; DMC-TZ37/TZ40/TZ41/ZS27/ZS30, TZ55/TZ56/ZS35, TZ57/TZ58/ZS45, TZ60/TZ61/ZS40/SZ8, TZ70/TZ71/ZS50, TZ80/TZ81/ZS60; DC-TZ90/TZ91/TZ92/TZ93/ZS70, TZ95/TZ95D/TZ96/TZ96D/TZ97/ZS80/ZS80D, TZ100/TZ101/TZ110/ZS100/ZS110, TZ200/TZ200D/TZ202/TZ202D/TZ220/TZ220D/ZS200/ZS200D/ZS220/ZS220D, FT7/TS7, TZ99/ZS99, and TZ300/ZS300.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There are no accounts, ads, analytics, trackers, or cloud uploads. Camera traffic stays on the direct local Wi-Fi connection. The app requests Photos access to save imports and, when enabled, check for existing originals to avoid duplicates.

promotionalText: New: shoot remotely with live view, receive each photo on your iPhone as you take it, and write your GPS track into the camera's photos.
whatsNew:
A new home screen: start the location log, then pick what you want to do with your camera. Retro LUMIX Sync shows the camera steps for each and can join the camera's Wi-Fi for you.

Remote shooting: see the camera's live view on your iPhone, take photos and videos, tap to focus, and change exposure settings.

Receive photos while you shoot: with the camera's Send Images While Recording mode, each photo is saved to Apple Photos as you take it.

Write locations to your camera: the camera adds GPS data from your recorded track to the photos on its card, and you can set its clock from your iPhone.

Also fixes problems with importing, reconnecting to the camera, and geotagging.
